% A list of tocloft's \newlistof. The default build of this document,
% with no list beside it, only carries the jobs of run.mjs that check
% draft builds. Those build in draft mode the documents of
% test-staletoc-draft/, each beside the list that pdflatex wrote for it,
% and the test-staleaux-toc fixtures, each beside its stale lists, then
% each document again with no list beside it. They also build this
% document in full and then in draft mode, in one folder, beside the stale
% list of test-staleaux-toc-color.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tocloft}
\newlistof{example}{exp}{Examples}
\newcommand{\example}[1]{\refstepcounter{example}\par\noindent Example~\theexample: #1%
  \addcontentsline{exp}{example}{\protect\numberline{\theexample}#1}\par}
\begin{document}
\listofexample
\section{First}
Text of the first section.
\example{A new example}
\end{document}
